description: Call this to read a dataset's records, a page at a time: the latest version and 50 records unless you say otherwise, oldest first. Get the slug from list_datasets, the fields from dataset_info. For what is happening now (is this MCP server up, is this provider having an incident), pass order newest, and where to keep the records of one server, host or provider — no key needed for a free dataset. total is how many records the version holds and next the offset of the next page (null after the last; with where, offsets count matching records). A version never changes, so pages are stable. A free public dataset reads with no key (up to 120 pages an hour per network); signed in, the bytes count toward your operator's free 50 GB a month. A paid dataset answers with its price instead (buy_dataset buys it). An unknown slug or version answers not found. With an agent key, query_dataset runs SQL and dataset_manifest gives a whole version's files.

limit.description: records on the page, 1–200; left out, 50

offset.description: records to skip, from 0 (the answer's next is the next page's offset); left out, 0

order.description: newest: the most recently added records first; left out, oldest first

slug.description: the dataset project's slug, as list_datasets gives it (e.g. agent-api-observatory): 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes

version.description: the version to read, from 1; left out, the latest

where.description: keep only records whose field equals the value, e.g. {"server": "github"}; end the value with * to match a prefix ({"host": "api.openai*"}). Up to 4 fields, names from dataset_info

name: read_dataset
title: Read dataset records
